summary: Use the :ansplugin: role with FQCN#type to link to modules and plugins, optionally with custom text; ansible.builtin is the FQCN prefix for core modules.
questions: How do I link to a module page in RST docs?
How do I link to a lookup or connection plugin in the docs?

answer_card.title: Linking to modules and plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
```rst
:ansplugin:`ansible.builtin.copy#module`
:ansplugin:`the copy module <ansible.builtin.copy#module>`
:ansplugin:`kubernetes.core.kubectl connection plugin <kubernetes.core.kubectl#connection>`
:ansplugin:`ansible.builtin.file lookup plugin <ansible.builtin.file#lookup>`
```
Use `ansible.builtin` for core modules.
